findings.issue: detectTestRunner() returns null when no runner detected, but runTaskTests() unconditionally destructures: `const { cmd, args } = detectTestRunner(testFiles)`. Destructuring null throws TypeError, crashing regression tests silently (caught by outer try-catch, reported as test failure).
findings.recommendation: Guard: `const runner = detectTestRunner(testFiles); if (!runner) return { taskId, skipped: true, reason: 'No test runner detected' }; const { cmd, args } = runner;`

findings.issue: runValidationCommand() interpolates filePath into shell command via execSync(). filePath from hook toolInput can contain shell metacharacters. The `replace('{file}', ...)` does not escape the path, allowing command injection in crafted filenames.
findings.recommendation: Replace execSync with execFileSync and split command into [cmd, ...args]. Or validate filePath against /^[\w.\-/]+$/.

findings.issue: Validation commands read from config (config.hooks.rules.validation.commands) are passed to execSync without metacharacter validation. A malicious config.json can inject arbitrary shell commands that execute on every file edit.
findings.recommendation: Validate command strings against UNSAFE_CHARS pattern from flow-script-resolver.js. Reject strings containing ;|&$`().

findings.issue: runCoverageTests() assembles coverage command via string interpolation (`npx c8 ${testCmd}`) and passes to execSync(). Combines two PM-detection issues: hardcoded npx AND shell interpolation of testCmd.
findings.recommendation: Use execFileSync with array args: decompose into [binary, ...args] pattern already used in flow-regression.js.

findings.issue: getConfig referenced but never imported. The guard `getConfig ? getConfig() : {}` always evaluates to false, making the config-based component directory suggestion permanently dead code.
findings.recommendation: Add getConfig to the destructured import from flow-utils on line 23.

findings.issue: eslintCmd is always truthy because getExec() never returns null. This means ESLint validation runs on .js/.jsx files even on projects without ESLint, causing false validation failures.
findings.recommendation: Only use eslint fallback if ESLint is detectable (check node_modules/.bin/eslint or devDependencies).

findings.issue: Placeholder mismatch: validation.js uses {file} for substitution, claude-bridge.js generates commands with [file]. If user inherits bridge-generated lint config, validation.js won't substitute the placeholder, passing literal '[file]' to eslint.
findings.recommendation: Standardize on {file} across both files. Change claude-bridge.js lines 86 and 201.

findings.issue: Bare JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(...)) for component-index.json without safeJsonParse() wrapper. Missing try-catch. Violates project security-patterns.md Rule #2.
findings.recommendation: Replace with safeJsonParse() from flow-utils.js.

findings.issue: resolveImportPath() joins user-controlled importSource with no path containment check. Can resolve outside PROJECT_ROOT via ../../../etc/passwd imports.
findings.recommendation: Add path.resolve(candidate).startsWith(PROJECT_ROOT + path.sep) check before fs.existsSync.

findings.issue: resolvePathAlias() uses bare JSON.parse on tsconfig.json without safeJsonParse(). Violates security-patterns.md Rule #2.
findings.recommendation: Use safeJsonParse() instead of manual strip-then-parse.

findings.issue: generateSettings() appends config.permissions.allowedDomains and custom permissions to settings.local.json without validation. Crafted config values can inject arbitrary permission rules.
findings.recommendation: Validate domain strings with strict regex. Reject custom strings containing shell metacharacters.

findings.issue: Polyglot project detection: Python/Go/Rust language detection overwrites Node.js language but leaves JS framework fields intact, creating incoherent stack reports (language: Python, frameworks.frontend: React).
findings.recommendation: Clear conflicting JS framework fields when non-JS primary language detected, or check non-JS first.

findings.issue: detectSourceRoot() falls back to 'src' even when src/ doesn't exist. JSDoc says fallback is '.' but code returns 'src'. Causes wrong @/ alias resolution on non-src projects.
findings.recommendation: Change fallback to '.' (project root) to match JSDoc and be least-wrong.

findings.issue: --passWithNoTests is Jest/Vitest-specific but appended to ALL unknown test runners (mocha, tap, ava, custom). These runners reject the unknown flag.
findings.recommendation: Only append --passWithNoTests when runner is identified as Jest or Vitest.

findings.issue: Three parallel PM detection implementations. flow-context-init.js misses bun.lock (newer filename). SCRIPT_MAPPINGS in installer and SCRIPT_ALIASES in resolver disagree on aliases for fix, typecheck, test.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to single detectPackageManager() in flow-script-resolver.js. Sync script alias maps.

findings.issue: _detectSourceRoot() re-requires fs and path inside method body (already available at module level) and uses process.cwd() instead of PROJECT_ROOT. Duplicates detectSourceRoot() from flow-code-intelligence.js.
findings.recommendation: Remove redundant requires. Use PROJECT_ROOT. Consider importing from flow-code-intelligence.js.

findings.issue: securityScan suggestions still use hardcoded 'npm audit fix'. Inconsistent with the rest of the file which uses getExecCommand(detectPackageManager()).
findings.recommendation: Replace with PM-aware command generation.

findings.issue: generateFromTemplate() mutates caller's config object in place. Inconsistent with generateDefaultClaudeMd() which uses local variables.
findings.recommendation: Clone config before mutating: const config = { ...configParam, scripts: { ...(configParam.scripts || {}) } }.

findings.issue: detectPackageManager imported but never used. Dead import.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused import.

findings.issue: getCommand/getExec required 4 times inline via try-catch instead of once at module top level.
findings.recommendation: Move require to module level.

findings.issue: SAFE_PATH regex defined inside function body, recompiled on every call.
findings.recommendation: Hoist to module level.
